description.fun: Number 001 in the National Pokédex: a frog-like Pokémon with a plant bulb that grew from a seed planted on its back at birth. The bulb soaks up sunlight, so Bulbasaur can go for days without eating, and it hides two vines strong enough to haul it up trees to reach Berries. It's one of only two first partner Pokémon with two types from the start; the other is Rowlet.
description.guide: A small, frog-like Grass and Poison Pokémon carrying a plant bulb that grew from a seed planted on its back at birth. The bulb gathers energy from sunlight and hides two vines it uses to climb and grab things. It is one of the first partner Pokémon of Kanto and evolves into Ivysaur.
description.tagline: Pokédex No. 001: a little frog with a sunbathing seed on its back

description.fun: Ivysaur's bulb has opened into a big pink bud, and carrying it is hard work: the weight stops Ivysaur from running fast or standing on its hind legs, so its legs grow thick and sturdy. When the bud is ready to bloom it swells and gives off a sweet smell, and Ivysaur spends more and more time in the sun. Researchers can't even tell whether it's awake or asleep while it basks.
description.guide: The middle stage of Bulbasaur's line, carrying a large pink bud on a short trunk where Bulbasaur's bulb used to be. The weight of the plant makes its legs grow strong, and when the bud is about to bloom it swells and gives off a sweet scent. It evolves into Venusaur.
description.tagline: Bulbasaur's bud, heavy enough to keep it on all fours

description.fun: Venusaur's huge flower soaks up sunlight and turns it into energy, so it's at its strongest in summer, and its soothing scent calms people and Pokémon alike, especially after a rainy day. It's one of Ken Sugimori's favourite Pokémon and also his least favourite to draw, because the design is so complex. Mega Venusaur, together with Mega Blastoise, was the first Mega Evolution in the Trading Card Game.
description.guide: The final stage of Bulbasaur's line, a large, frog-like Pokémon carrying a big pink flower that turns sunlight into energy. The flower's scent soothes people and Pokémon. Venusaur can Mega Evolve into Mega Venusaur and has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: A walking flower garden that's strongest in summer

description.fun: Its flower grows bigger and two smaller blooms appear, one on its forehead and one on its rear. Sturdier legs and back carry the extra weight, and its toughened body can withstand almost any attack.

Its flower blooms so far that it covers its whole body, with thick, springy petals that work as a shield. Its vines can topple a 10-storey building, and its pollen bursts out like a volcanic eruption, setting anyone who breathes it sneezing.
